claim: A peer-reviewed reconstruction estimated that about 1,680 tonnes of plastic nurdles were spilled from X-Press Pearl in May 2021.

metric.denominator: preproduction plastic pellets/nurdles estimated spilled from X-Press Pearl
metric.geography: Sri Lankan coast, spill originating off Colombo
metric.basis: scientific reconstruction from ship cargo and spill evidence
metric.source_definition: nurdle/preproduction plastic mass, not all ship pollutants

bounded_by: Does not represent total plastic entering Sri Lankan waters in 2021 or chronic national plastic leakage.
notes: Acute-event metric with explicit pollutant denominator.
